profile.headline: Software Engineer 3 at Harris Corporation
profile.summary:
Accomplished software engineer with over 15 years experience designing, implementing and supporting commercial software products built with C and C++ on Linux and Windows. Creative and resourceful, highly focused professional. Team player with good writing and presentation skills.

* Refactored a desktop application consisting of roughly a dozen editors and more than 200 dialogs to replace a legacy, cross-platform GUI library with Qt, which required adapting original C code and structures to use C++ classes provided by Qt.

* Designed and implemented a complex C++ class hierarchy to represent military-specific concepts in the OPNET Modeler application, involving multiple-level inheritance, polymorphism and design patterns.

* Wrote, reviewed and lead training sessions for 10 annual OPNET user conferences, which provided detailed technical training to an average of 500 users each year.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description: * Designed and developed features for multi-channel radios on an embedded C++ platform.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
* Debugged and enhanced capabilities for the network simulation process to exchange live traffic with the real network via pcap, involving bit-level manipulation of network packets and analysis with Wireshark.

* Refactored routing protocol simulation code to use Standard Template Library (STL) containers, resulting in greater than 20% speed increase.

company.name: Riverbed Technology Inc. (formerly OPNET Technologies, Inc.)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and debugged cross-platform GUI application features in C on Linux and Windows, utilizing source control in ClearCase and git, after transitioning from Professional Services to the core engineering team.

* Implemented the ability to perform text searches across more than 20 binary file types utilized by OPNET Modeler and to jump from search results directly to matches.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Implemented a detailed world map rendering capability in Java for a desktop application.
* Refactored application build scripts to reduce build times and improve installer reliability.
* Wrote software designs for contract requirements documents, including presentation to clients.
* Led development team in providing support to users of our custom software product.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed an XML export capability utilizing XML Schema Definition (XSD) for validation.
* Refactored GUI application internals to greatly reduce time to load data files.
* Interviewed and mentored junior software engineers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed custom GUI features for the OPNET Modeler application using C++ on Windows.
* Developed a capability to incrementally load data to reduce memory use and improve responsiveness.
* Designed a SQL database schema to store military-specific traffic descriptions.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
* Developed MS-DOS and Windows applications in C and Pascal to extract call data from telephone switches. 
* Provided on-site customer assistance for major deployments.
* Led a development team including two junior programmers.
